newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X falls, Barrick soars on news.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X falls, Barrick soars on news.

text.p: Shares in Bre-X Resources Ltd tumbled and those in Barrick Gold Corp soared after Bre-X said the Indonesian government had advised it to form a joint venture with Barrick.

The joint venture suggested by the government would give Barrick 75 percent of Bre-X's stake in the massive Busang gold deposit and Bre-X 25 percent. Barrick later confirmed that it was negotiating with Bre-X about Busang.
Bre-X tumbled to 18.50 after trade resumed at 1400 EST/1900 GMT. It then recovered slightly but was still down 2.15 -- up from its low before the release -- at 20.40.
Barrick leapt 3.45 to 40.00 in brisk dealings on Toronto. It surged 2-3/8 to 29-1/2 on the New York Stock Exchange.
Traders said there remains a great deal of confusion about the impact of the deal on Bre-X.
"It's a mug's game (to guess what will happen) right now," said one trader.
"Obviously there are no numbers out there so what this means for Bre-X shareholders in terms of dollars and cents is impossible to know," he added.
The dealer said the news is clearly a boon for Barrick, North America's largest gold company.
-- Sarah Edmonds, Reuters Toronto Bureau (416) 941-8100, E-mail sarah.edmonds@reuters.com
